name: UXArmy
description_en:
UXArmy combines remote usability research, live interviews and information-architecture testing. DeepDive is its moderated research environment, while unmoderated tests, card sorting and tree testing answer different questions.

The current pricing uses pooled credits across methods. Study count alone is a poor capacity estimate because response costs and participant recruitment charges differ.
description_zh:
UXArmy 集合远程可用性研究、实时访谈和信息架构测试。DeepDive 用于主持研究，无主持人测试、卡片分类和树测试则回答不同问题。

当前套餐采用跨方法共享的 credits。仅看研究数量无法估计容量，因为不同回复消耗和参与者招募费用不同。

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Choose the method before the plan
sections.title_zh: 先选研究方法，再选套餐
sections.en: For usability work, UXArmy documents screen/audio recording, task logic, Figma integration and heatmaps. DeepDive supports live interviews and group sessions, with a separate analysis space for notes, highlights and transcripts. Card sorting studies grouping choices; tree testing examines whether people can locate items in a hierarchy. A heatmap does not explain motivation without the task and spoken context.
sections.zh: 可用性研究功能包括屏幕和音频录制、任务逻辑、Figma 接入及热力图。DeepDive 支持实时访谈和小组研究，并有整理笔记、片段与转录的分析空间。卡片分类研究分组方式，树测试研究人们能否在层级中找到内容。热力图需要任务和口述背景才能帮助解释动机。

sections.title_en: Example: diagnose a support navigation problem
sections.title_zh: 示例：诊断帮助中心导航问题
sections.en: First use card sorting to explore how participants group support topics. Turn a proposed hierarchy into a tree test asking where they would cancel a subscription. If the destination remains hard to find, run a recorded prototype task to inspect label interpretation and interaction. Importing cards or a hierarchy can reduce setup repetition, but the wording and success destination still need editorial decisions. This sequence is hypothetical, not a measured UXArmy result.
sections.zh: 先用卡片分类了解参与者如何归组帮助主题，再把候选层级转成树测试，询问取消订阅应到哪里。如果仍难找到目标，可以通过录制原型任务检查标签理解和交互。导入卡片或层级可减少重复配置，但措辞与正确目标仍需要研究者决定。该顺序是假设示例，并非实测结果。

sections.title_en: Pooled credits do not include every recruitment cost
sections.title_zh: 共享 credits 不涵盖全部招募费用
sections.en: The page shows Free with one full seat and 15 monthly credits, Starter at $29/month with 29 credits and Pro at $99/month with 99 credits in its monthly view. A recorded advanced usability response is listed as five credits: three such responses would consume the Free allocation, assuming no other usage. Panel access/recruitment is an add-on rather than an included sample. Some no-recording table rates do not reconcile with the displayed response counts, so those rates are not reproduced here. Confirm consumption in the platform before launch.
sections.zh: 页面月付视图显示：Free 有一个完整席位和每月 15 credits；Starter 每月 29 美元、29 credits；Pro 每月 99 美元、99 credits。带录制的高级可用性回复列为每条五 credits，因此若没有其他用量，三条会用完免费额度。样本库访问与招募是附加项，并非附赠样本。部分无录制方法的费率与显示回复数无法对应，因此本文不转述这些费率，应在发布前核对平台内消耗。

sections.title_zh: 核对录制时长和原始片段
sections.en: Although the pricing page says unlimited test length, the comparison table caps individual recordings at 50 minutes unmoderated and three hours moderated. These statements describe different limits. Before launch, pilot permissions and recording on the intended device, and review source clips behind AI summaries. The product is relevant to teams mixing research methods; contractual privacy, hosting options and source licensing need separate checks rather than assuming a compliance badge settles data eligibility.
sections.zh: 虽然套餐页写测试长度不限，对照表仍把单次录制限制为无主持人 50 分钟、主持研究三小时，两者指不同限制。发布前应在目标设备试点检查权限和录制，并复查 AI 摘要对应的原始片段。需要混合研究方法的团队可考虑它；合同隐私、托管选项和源码许可需另查，不能仅凭合规标识判断数据是否适用。

research_gaps.en: Resolve card-sort/tree-test rate versus response-count inconsistencies before budgeting; verify panel costs and contractual retention.
research_gaps.zh: 预算前需解决卡片分类和树测试费率与回复数不一致，并确认招募费用及合同保留期限。

research_gaps.en: No live account, purchase, recovery or performance test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际创建账户、购买、测试恢复或测量性能。
